def create_avoir_journal_entry_for_sales_order(customer, company, sales_order, amount, receivable_account):
    je = frappe.new_doc("Journal Entry")
    je.voucher_type = "Credit Note"
    je.posting_date = frappe.utils.nowdate()
    je.company= company
    je.user_remark = f"Avoir client utilisé pour la commande {sales_order}"
    je.cheque_no=f"Avoir client {customer} utilisé pour la commande {sales_order}"
    je.cheque_date=frappe.utils.nowdate()
        # 🔽 Champ supplémentaire : Moyen de paiement
    je.mode_of_payment = "Avoir client"  # Doit exister dans vos options

    # 🔽 Champ Écriture d'ouverture
    je.is_opening = "No"  # ou 0 si champ booléen
    # Ligne 1 : Débit du client (montant en attente)
    je.append("accounts", {
        "account": receivable_account,
        "party_type": "Customer",
        "party": customer,
        "debit_in_account_currency": amount,
        "reference_type": "",  # pas de référence ici
        "reference_name": ""
    })

    # Ligne 2 : Crédit du client avec lien vers la commande
    je.append("accounts", {
        "account": receivable_account,
        "party_type": "Customer",
        "party": customer,
        "credit_in_account_currency": amount,
        "reference_type": "Sales Order",
        "reference_name": sales_order,
        "user_remark": f"Application de l’avoir à {sales_order}"
    })
    
    # Enregistrement et soumission
    je.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
    je.submit()

    return je.name

def grant_temp_role(user_email, role_name="Accounts User"):
    """Add role to user temporarily."""
    user = frappe.get_doc("User", user_email)
    if not any(r.role == role_name for r in user.roles):
        user.append("roles", {"role": role_name})
        user.save(ignore_permissions=True)
        # frappe.clear_user_cache(user_email)
        return True  # role was added
    return False  # role already existed

def remove_temp_role(user_email, role_name="Accounts User"):
    """Remove temporarily added role from user."""
    user = frappe.get_doc("User", user_email)
    user.roles = [r for r in user.roles if r.role != role_name]
    user.save(ignore_permissions=True)

name: Autorisation Sales order partenaire
script:
partenaire={"HR-EMP-00007":"economiqaquasolutions23@gmail.com"}
frappe.flags.ignore_permissions = True

if doc.custom_choix_du_staff=="HR-EMP-00007":
    user_name=partenaire["HR-EMP-00007"]
    customer = doc.custom_client
    is_closed = doc.status in ("Completed", "Cancelled")
    # Accès client : partager le Customer ET ses adresses (read = if_owner sur
    # Customer et Address) pour permettre la création de commande. Retiré à la
    # fermeture si plus aucune tâche partenaire ouverte ne référence ce client.
    def partner_targets(cust):
        targets = [("Customer", cust)]
        addrs = frappe.get_all("Dynamic Link", filters={"link_doctype": "Customer",
            "link_name": cust, "parenttype": "Address"}, pluck="parent")
        targets += [("Address", a) for a in addrs]
        return targets
    # Acces client : TOUJOURS partager le Customer + adresses AVANT toute
    # operation (submit commande, paiements, BL). Le retrait se fait en fin de script.
    if customer:
        for dt, dn in partner_targets(customer):
            if not frappe.db.exists("DocShare", {"share_doctype": dt, "share_name": dn, "user": user_name}):
                cs = frappe.get_doc({
                    "doctype": "DocShare", "share_doctype": dt, "share_name": dn,
                    "user": user_name, "read": 1, "write": 0, "share": 1, "everyone": 0})
                cs.flags.ignore_permissions = True
                cs.flags.ignore_share_permission = True
                cs.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
    shared = frappe.db.exists(
        "DocShare",
        {
            "share_doctype": "Tache de travail",
            "share_name": doc.name,
            "user": user_name
        }
    )
    shared=bool(shared)
    
    if not shared:
        docshare = frappe.get_doc({
        "doctype": "DocShare",
        "share_doctype": "Tache de travail",
        "share_name": doc.name,
        "user": user_name,
        "read": 1,
        "write": 1
        })
        docshare.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
    
    sales_order=doc.commande_client
    
    if sales_order:
        shared = frappe.db.exists(
        "DocShare",
        {
            "share_doctype": "Sales Order",
            "share_name": sales_order,
            "user": user_name
        }
        )
        shared=bool(shared)
        if not shared:
            docshare = frappe.get_doc({
                "doctype": "DocShare",
                "share_doctype": "Sales Order",
                "share_name": sales_order,
                "user": user_name,
                "read": 1,
                "write": 1,
                "submit": 1
            })
            docshare.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
            
        # add BL adjustement is 
        if doc.status == "Completed":
            # Finalisation (validation commande + paiements + BL consolide)
            # executee EN ARRIERE-PLAN en tant qu'Administrator : le partenaire
            # n'a pas les permissions Payment Entry / Delivery Note.
            # enqueue_after_commit : la tache (statut + commande) doit etre
            # persistee avant le job.
            # La commande DOIT contenir un article "Main d’œuvre" pour que le BL
            # soit lie nativement a la commande (sinon impossible -> on alerte et bloque).
            mo_items = frappe.get_all("Sales Order Item", filters={"parent": sales_order}, pluck="item_code")
            has_mo = any(frappe.db.get_value("Item", ic, "item_group") == "Main d’œuvre" for ic in mo_items)
            if not has_mo:
                frappe.throw("La commande " + str(sales_order) + " ne contient pas d'article « Main d’œuvre ». Ajoutez-en un a la commande avant de fermer la tache (necessaire pour lier le bon de livraison).")
            frappe.enqueue("customization_app.api.partner_finalize_order",
                task=doc.name, enqueue_after_commit=True)
    # Retrait des partages APRES toutes les operations (submit/paiements/BL),
    # a la fermeture, si plus aucune tache partenaire ouverte ne reference ce client.
    if customer and is_closed:
        autres = frappe.db.count("Tache de travail", {
            "custom_choix_du_staff": "HR-EMP-00007",
            "custom_client": customer,
            "status": ["not in", ["Completed", "Cancelled"]],
            "name": ["!=", doc.name]})
        if not autres:
            for dt, dn in partner_targets(customer):
                ds_name = frappe.db.get_value("DocShare", {"share_doctype": dt, "share_name": dn, "user": user_name}, "name")
                if ds_name:
                    frappe.delete_doc("DocShare", ds_name, ignore_permissions=True)

CHILD_TABLE_FIELD = "stats_journaliere"
row_today = None
for r in doc.get(CHILD_TABLE_FIELD) or []:
    if frappe.utils.getdate(r.date) == today:
        row_today = r
        break
if not row_today:
    row_today = doc.append(CHILD_TABLE_FIELD, {})
    row_today.date = today

# 4) Matin / Soir
if hour >= 19:
    row_today.soir = total
else:
    row_today.matin = total

# 5) Calcul nombre appels
matin = row_today.matin or 0
soir = row_today.soir or 0
row_today.nombre_appels = matin - soir

doc.save(ignore_permissions=True)

frappe.db.commit()
